[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Rezion''' was a [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] researcher on [[Byblos/Legends|Byblos]]. He wanted to defect to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] with his daughter, and the notes on an advanced [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting computer]] he was developing.
